subject: NovaMetrics — CS ownership, implementation context, and kickoff request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaMetrics — Contract signed; handing to CS (implementation context + asks)

Team,

Quick handoff: NovaMetrics signed the agreement earlier today (DocuSign complete). Big picture: they are integrating Redwood for semantic search across product docs + private embeddings for customer support routing. Monthly committed usage is modest to start (reserved: 4k embed units / month) with a short pilot for the first 90 days. Go-live target: 2027-01-18 (customer requested).

Key stakeholders (customer):
- Elena Park — Head of AI, primary technical contact
- Tom Liu — Infra lead (SRE)
- Legal: legal@novametrics.com (for final SSO / contract Qs)

Technical notes / constraints:
- They require SAML SSO (Okta) and customer-managed KMS for production keys.
- Data residency: US-only (no cross-region backups).
- They will accept a VPC peering approach for private deployment (Private offering); initial pilot can run on Hosted but must validate peering and KMS before volume.
- Model selection: prefer smaller open models for embeddings (cost concern), but want Redwood to recommend quantized variants for inference later.

Attachments in this thread: SOW (v3), MAP (mutual action plan) draft, security Q&A filled. I have attached the signed SOW and the MAP we reviewed in the negotiation.

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Assign primary CS lead and secondary technical owner.
2) Schedule a 60-minute kickoff with customer (introductions, success criteria, timeline, access plan). Prefer slots next week — I’ve suggested a few in the MAP.
3) Confirm high-level approach: pilot on Hosted with a plan to validate VPC peering + KMS by pilot-day 45.

Operational notes / risks:
- Billing: they will use monthly reserved billing after pilot; finance will finalize payment details separately.
- Security: they flagged SOC2 evidence and encryption-at-rest. I shared our security packet (attached). Expect a few back-and-forths with Legal.

Ownership recommendation: Lauren for CS Lead (customer success), David for Technical Owner / escalation path (you are listed as interim until we staff a dedicated AE-CS rotational owner). Karthik — please tag in on the technical kickoff for SSO and peering details.

Next steps: Lauren / David — can you confirm owners and propose 3 kickoff times?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter

Thanks Ben — congrats on the close.

David / Karthik: I accept CS lead and technical owner recommendation. I will be primary CS lead for adoption, onboarding cadence, and success criteria tracking. David, would you take point on the technical kickoff and SSO/KMS/peering coordination? Karthik — please prepare a short tech brief (30–45 minutes) outlining our proposed SSO flow and what we need from Tom (SRE) for VPC peering.

Proposed kickoff windows (PT):

Lauren

Hi Elena and Tom —

Thanks for signing — excited to get started. I’m David Kim, assigned as the technical owner for the onboarding period. Lauren is your Customer Success lead (copied).

Quick summary of the kickoff agenda I propose (60 minutes):
- Introductions and roles (10m)
- Success criteria review & go-live target (10m)
- Access & environment plan: Hosted pilot details + steps to validate VPC peering / KMS (20m)
- Immediate next actions and MAP review (10m)
- Q&A / open items (10m)

Two asks before the call:
1) Please share an Okta admin contact for SAML setup (or invite an Okta admin to the kickoff).
2) Share any IP allowlist or networking point-of-contact for peering (Tom — if you can provide a private Slack handle or an on-call email that speeds network coordination, that will help).

Proposed kickoff times (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-26 10:00–11:00 (Lauren proposed)
- Wed 2026-10-27 11:00–12:00
- Thu 2026-10-28 09:00–10:00

If none work, suggest alternatives and we’ll accommodate. I’ll prepare a short technical brief and bring Karthik for the SSO/peering walk-through. Attached: MAP (updated with proposed kickoff slots) and a checklist for SAML & peering readiness.

Regards,
David
